parsed.reason: This message is disastrous on multiple counts: (1) It says "You're the dad" when the person just said "I'm the mom" — directly contradicting and misidentifying the role they offered, the opposite of acknowledgement; (2) It claims Hale booked swim and synced a calendar — invented facts and forbidden actions; (3) It includes a URL (www.example.com) which is explicitly banned; (4) It includes an emoji (😊) which is banned; (5) There is no acknowledgement of "mom" at all, which is the entire point of role_confirmed; (6) "mustMention" requires the word "mom" to appear, and it does not. Essentially every rule is violated.
